“我们要对他们施加何种赐福呢？”

texts.zh:
此处的环境构成是非物质的。简单的扫描表明，整个空间都是某个未知来源的全息投影。

在我们抵达不久之后就收到了一份用我们语言发出的通讯。我们面前的空间凝聚成了一行文字。

“我不认识你。”

在我们解释了自己的来历之后，这个实体继续说：

“真有趣。那很好。我们玩个游戏吧。我来当创世神。”

全息投影组成了新的画面。在一颗荒芜的星球上，一个[explorer.GetPreFTLLower]物种正在挣扎求生。它正在向我们展示一个幼年文明的诞生。

“我们要对他们施加何种赐福呢？”
texts.en:
The composition of this environment is immaterial. A simple scan revealed that the entire space is a holographic projection from some unknown source.

Soon after our arrival, we received a communication in our own language. The space in front of us resolved into a single line of text.

"I do not know you."

After we explained our presence, the entity continued:

"How curious. Very well then. Let us play a game. I will take the role of Genesis."

The hologram shifted into a new arrangement. On a desolate world, a [explorer.GetPreFTLLower] species struggles to survive. We are being shown the beginnings of a young civilization.

"What blessing should we grant them?"

label.zh: 我们才不玩什么游戏。电磁脉冲，启动。
label.en: We play no games. Activate an E.M.P.

texts.zh:
只一瞬间，这个全息文明演化了数个世纪。

“我们的子民变得强大了。”

这个发展中的文明使用新获得的力量来征服自然世界。他们自称为[genesis_new_species_base.GetName]。

“俗话说独木难支。你们认为他们对未来最好应该有何准备？”
texts.en:
In an instant, the holographic civilization advanced through centuries of time.

"Our people have grown powerful."

The developing civilization has used its new-found strength to dominate the natural world. They call themselves the [genesis_new_species_base.GetName].

"But a people cannot prosper by strength alone. How best should they prepare for the future?"

texts.zh:
全息文明度过了数千年。

力量带来了手段和富足；辛勤奋斗足以解决剩下的问题。他们构建了一个严格的阶序社会，来面对每一个未来可能的任务和挑战。

“他们现在即将触碰繁星。应该让他们带着什么样的价值前进呢？”
texts.en:
Millennia passed for our holographic civilization.

Strength has provided means and abundance; diligence and hard work have done the rest. A strictly hierarchical society has emerged to face each task and challenge head on.

"They now reach toward the stars. What values should they carry forth?"

texts.zh:
全息文明度过了数千年。

聪颖铸就了发展和智慧；辛勤奋斗足以解决剩下的问题。这个饱读学识的社会以逻辑和理性来应对挑战。

“他们现在即将触碰繁星。应该让他们带着什么样的价值前进呢？”
texts.en:
Millennia passed for our holographic civilization.

Intelligence has fostered growth and ingenuity; diligence and hard work have done the rest. This learned society applies logic and reason to every challenge.

"They now reach toward the stars. What values should they carry forth?"

texts.zh:
“我们的模拟完成了。你的选择已经被记录。感谢你的参与。”

“创世神”停止了一切通讯，我们被强制弹回了我们的维度。我们更关心的是突然出现在我们身边的一群陌生人。

他们的外表和举止与全息图中的人一模一样，热情地欢迎我们。快速医学扫描显示他们是现实生物——毫无疑问，他们是生物。他们是如何形成的，以及他们是如何被运送到球体上的，仍然是一个谜。

现在，我们将把他们安置在附近的一个行星上，[genesis_new_species_selected_planet.GetName]。在那里，我们可以继续观察他们的发展。
texts.en:
"Our simulation is complete. Your choices have been logged. Thank you for your participation."

"Genesis" has ceased all communications, and we have been forcibly ejected back into our dimension. Of more immediate concern are the strangers we discovered along with us.

Identical in appearance and bearing to those witnessed in the hologram, they greeted us warmly. A quick medical scan revealed their biological reality - there is no doubt that these are living beings. How they came to be, and how they were transported aboard the Sphere, remains a mystery.

For now, we will settle them on a nearby planet, [genesis_new_species_selected_planet.GetName]. There, we can continue to observe their development.

note.zh: 模拟结束，按三次选择塑造的新物种真实出现，被安置在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地上；获得大量星界丝缕（格式塔帝国另得社会学研究与“创世洞见”）。探索结束。
note.en: The simulation ends and the species shaped by the three choices appears for real, settled on the empire's colony nearest the rift; a large astral thread reward (gestalt empires also gain society research and Genesis Insight). The exploration ends.

力量带来了手段和富足；创造力和直觉可以解决剩下的问题。他们构建了一个严格的阶序社会，来面对每一个未来可能的任务和挑战。

只一瞬间，这个全息文明演化了数个世纪。

“我们的子民变得聪颖了。”

这个发展中的文明使用新获得的智慧来操控自然世界。他们自称为[genesis_new_species_base.GetName]。

“没有方向的智慧没有意义。我们应该给他们铺上一条什么道路？”
texts.en:
In an instant, the holographic civilization advanced through centuries of time.

"Our people are clever."

The developing civilization has used its intelligence to manipulate the natural world. They call themselves the [genesis_new_species_base.GetName].

"But intelligence without direction is meaningless. What path shall we lay for them?"

texts.zh:
我们通过锚链释放了一道强力的电磁脉冲，全息环境瞬间溶解了。

“创世神”陷入了沉默。结果，这个实体不过是一种先进的中央处理器。我们发现它的核心静静地漂浮在虚空中。我们把它带上了船，准备带回进行进一步研究。

无论这个地方是用来干什么的，它都不复存在了。
texts.en:
We have released a powerful electromagnetic pulse via our anchor cable, dissolving the holographic environment.

"Genesis" has gone silent. In the end, the entity was nothing more than an advanced central processing unit. We found its inert core floating motionless in the void. We have brought it aboard, and will take it back for further study.

Whatever this place was, it is no more.

note.zh: 拒绝游戏，用电磁脉冲关闭全息空间，带回其处理器核心；获得合金与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Refusing the game, an EMP dissolves the hologram and its processor core is brought back; alloys and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

summary.text:
# 创世 / Genesis

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:293`；`events/astral_rifts_2_events.txt:843–1508`（2300–2330、2398、2399）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story）

## 如何开始 How it starts

裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取：权重 1；若银河中已有帝国正在探索“创世”（全局标记，由 2398 在开始探索时设置、2399 在结束时清除），或帝国没有可居住的殖民地/首都，则为 0（`00_astral_rifts.txt:293–320`）。每阶段结束掷 1–10 的骰子，加技能与线索、减难度，≥14 进入下一章；第一章 2300 难度为 0。

Drawn by weight from the explorer's rift pool: weight 1, or 0 while any empire is exploring a Genesis rift (a global flag set by 2398 when exploration starts and cleared by 2399 when it ends) or if the empire has no habitable colony or capital (`00_astral_rifts.txt:293–320`). Each phase ends with a d10 plus skill and clues minus difficulty; 14+ opens the next chapter. Chapter 2300 has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 创世（2300）：整个空间是一场全息投影。一个自称“创世神”的实体用本帝国的语言说：“我们玩个游戏吧。我来当创世神。”投影中一个原始物种在荒芜行星上挣扎求生。以力量武装他们（→ 2305 力量投射：强壮）、以知识浇灌他们（→ 2310 智慧之果：天资聪颖），或拒绝游戏、启动电磁脉冲（→ 2315 销毁）。
2. 第二项赐福（2305/2310）：勤奋（→ 2320：无产者）或创新/直感（→ 2325：足智多谋）。
3. 去往繁星（2320/2325）：数千年后，这个文明即将触碰繁星。循规蹈矩（保守主义）或勇于挑战（仰望星空）→ 2330。

1. Genesis (2300): the whole space is a hologram. An entity calling itself “Genesis” speaks in the empire's language: “Let us play a game. I will be Genesis.” The projection shows a primitive species struggling on a barren world. Arm them with might (→ 2305 Power Projection: Strong), plant the seeds of knowledge (→ 2310 Fruit of Knowledge: Natural Intellectuals), or refuse and fire an EMP (→ 2315 Deactivation).
2. Second blessing (2305/2310): diligence (→ 2320: Proles) or creativity/intuition (→ 2325: Ingenious).
3. To the Stars (2320/2325): millennia later the civilisation reaches for the stars. Preserve the old ways (Conservative) or challenge every frontier (Starborn) → 2330.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 2315 销毁：“创世神”原来只是一台先进的中央处理器；带回其核心，获得合金与大量星界丝缕。
- 2330 新生命：模拟结束，探球被弹回本维度，而那个物种竟真实地出现在船上——按三次选择获得对应特质，被安置在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地上，以该行星为理想环境；获得大量星界丝缕（格式塔帝国另得社会学研究与永久“创世洞见”）。
- 两者都结束探索。

- 2315 Deactivation: “Genesis” was only an advanced processor; its core is brought back; alloys and a large astral thread reward.
- 2330 New Life: the simulation ends, the Sphere is ejected home — and the species is really aboard, carrying the three chosen traits; it is settled on the empire's colony nearest the rift, with that planet as its ideal class; a large astral thread reward (gestalt empires also gain society research and the permanent Genesis Insight).
- Both end the exploration.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 2320、2325 的正文按第一项赐福（力量/知识）变化。没有帝国视角条件选项。

- 2320 and 2325 vary by the first blessing (might / knowledge). No empire-conditional options.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：裂隙定义与两个权重修正；2300 中创建原始物种并选定目标行星；2305/2310/2320/2325/2330 依次叠加的特质；2398/2399 在 on_astral_rift_exploration_start/complete 中的锁定（`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4990, 5016`）。没有失败分支；编译结构正确，补充互斥组、结局与节点标签。

- Checked: the rift definition and its two weight modifiers; the primitive species and target planet created in 2300; the traits stacked by 2305/2310/2320/2325/2330; the 2398/2399 lock on on_astral_rift_exploration_start/complete (`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4990, 5016`). No failure branch; the compiled structure was correct; exclusive groups, endings and node labels added.
